message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – Key Points** | Topic | Summary | |-------|---------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits vary by road type (e.g., 55 mph on rural interstates, 45 mph on urban interstates).
• “No speed limit” zones exist on some rural highways. | | **Seat‑belt Law** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Drivers and front‑seat passengers must buckle up; rear‑seat passengers must use approved restraints. | | **Child Safety Seats** | • Children under 8 years or 4 feet 9 inches tall must be in a child safety seat or booster. | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (BAC 0.02% or higher). | | **Texting & Phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • At uncontrolled intersections, vehicles approaching from the right have priority.
• Pedestrians have priority at crosswalks. | | **Lane‑Changing & Passing** | • Must signal and check mirrors/blind spots.
• Passing on the right is generally prohibited unless the vehicle ahead is turning left. | | **School Bus Law** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children.
• Stopping distance: 20 feet for passenger cars, 30 feet for trucks. | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 feet of a fire hydrant, crosswalk, or intersection.
• Parking on sidewalks is prohibited unless marked otherwise. | | **Toll Roads** | • Texas has both toll and non‑toll roads.
• Toll roads require electronic toll tags (e.g., TxTag). | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • All vehicles must be registered and display valid license plates.
• Most vehicles must pass an annual safety inspection. | | **Insurance Requirements** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 bodily injury per person, $60,000 per accident, $25,000 property damage. | | **Special Vehicle Rules** | • Motorcycles require a motorcycle endorsement.
• Commercial vehicles must meet additional licensing and safety standards. | **Where to Find More Information** - Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV): [https://www.txdmv.gov](https://www.txdmv.gov) - Texas Transportation Code (Title 7, Chapter 1) - Texas Highway Patrol: [https://www.txdps.state.tx.us](https://www.txdps.state.tx.us) Feel free to let me know if you’d like details on a specific aspect of Texas traffic law!
